decision: Native retained readbacks are insufficient to compare any word-support end at sample precision. The exact support ranges are verified as input metadata, but no native getter exposes those per-word sample endpoints; complete sample omission remains ambiguous.

scope.allowedEvidence: Retained JSON/manifests only; no Resolve/API/UI/native calls and no media reads.

inputs.supportConvention: half-open integer PCM sample offsets; nonzero waveform support

commands: jq/python3 over 21 retained out/.../r2-*/pair.json files, both stable passes, audio tracks only
sha256sum over retained input and pair JSON artifacts

precisionObservation.sourceFrameGetters: Integer-valued in all retained observations; observed repeated.wav source end values: 60, 70, 100, 174, 199.
precisionObservation.sourceTimeGetters: Frame-grid values (1/25 s = 0.04 s) in retained observations; repeated.wav source end values: 2.4, 2.8, 4.0, 6.96, 7.96 (one 7.959999999999999 serialization).
precisionObservation.recordSubframeGetters: GetStart(True), GetEnd(True), and GetDuration(True) were serialized as floats but every audio observation was integral; no fractional subframe value was retained.
precisionObservation.sourceSubframeGetter: No source-space subframe or sample getter was present in the retained item records.

rangeComparisons.label: word-1
rangeComparisons.nativeObservation: No per-word endpoint. Full repeated.wav clip observations include source end 100/4.0 s, 174/6.96 s, or 199/7.96 s; these are clip bounds.
rangeComparisons.comparison: No native source frame/time/subframe readback equals or identifies 18.884375 frames / 0.755375 s.

rangeComparisons.label: word-2
rangeComparisons.nativeObservation: R2 linked and unlinked split pieces bracket the target with source bounds 60/2.4 s and 70/2.8 s; record GetEnd(True) is 2570.0 or 3070.0. No source endpoint at 68.884375/2.755375 is retained.
rangeComparisons.comparison: Observed boundaries are editorial frame cuts, not derived support end. The target lies 222 samples before the next integer frame boundary, but the retained getter cannot represent that sample offset.

rangeComparisons.label: word-3
rangeComparisons.nativeObservation: No per-word endpoint; retained repeated.wav clip bounds are frame-valued and include the full source.
rangeComparisons.comparison: No native source frame/time/subframe readback equals or identifies 118.884375 frames / 4.755375 s.

rangeComparisons.label: word-4
rangeComparisons.nativeObservation: No per-word endpoint; retained repeated.wav clip bounds are frame-valued and include the full source.
rangeComparisons.comparison: No native source frame/time/subframe readback equals or identifies 168.884375 frames / 6.755375 s.

limits: The input manifest and PCM support analysis establish source ranges only; this verification did not read media bytes.
Clip getters expose clip/source frame bounds and frame-grid source times, not individual nonzero sample-support ends.
GetEnd(True) is a record/timeline coordinate and cannot be treated as a source-sample endpoint.
Rounded, inferred, or bracketed endpoints do not prove complete sample omission or program-audio routing.
No native measurement is retained for exact word-1, word-3, or word-4 endpoints; word-2 has only the 60-to-70 frame bracket.
decisionNeeded: Main should treat R2-derived-end as unverified/unsupported for sample-accurate acceptance and retain the ambiguity. A future acceptance pass requires a native source-space sample/subframe readback or independently inspected rendered PCM aligned to the source ranges.
